$comment: The Spatial Adjust showcase film: the one config every pipeline tool reads, passed by path (--episode video/showcase/episode.json). Seeded from the beat sheet in video/showcase/concept.md, which it mirrors: beat ids, chapter labels, tcIn/tcOut, guideKeys and sources. Fields the episode schema (video/lib/episode-schema.mjs) does not define are showcase extensions; the schema keeps unknown fields and no pipeline tool reads them. Timings are seconds of the finished film. hold is capture time: the director holds each beat at least that long. Every VO line and on-screen label (beats[].labels[]) cites Verified claims from docs/claims/claims.json, or is a brand item; node video/showcase/check-claims.mjs enforces it and writes video/showcase/claims-check.md. Target Profiles is omitted (gate SC-TP in video/approvals.md). Each VO line also carries line (L1..L10, the numbering of video/showcase/vo-script.md), windowIn and windowOut (seconds of the finished film: the line must start and finish inside them) and ttsText. ttsText is a record, not an input: it is exactly the text video/vo/render-brian.py sends to ElevenLabs, which is text with video/vo/lexicon.json applied, and the renderer never reads ttsText. Change a pronunciation in the lexicon, not here; video/showcase/whisper-roundtrip.py fails while ttsText and the lexicon disagree. Captions and the transcript use text, never ttsText.
title: From scan to water

vo.text: In IntelliDash, Spatial Adjust turns the latest moisture scan into a percent adjustment, station by station.
vo.ttsText: In Intelli-Dash, Spatial Adjust turns the latest moisture scan into a percent adjustment, station by station.

vo.text: Each station's average VWC comes from a TurfRad moisture scan, dated beside the station name.
vo.ttsText: Each station's average V W C comes from a Turf Rad moisture scan, dated beside the station name.

vo.text: The map colours pins by measured moisture. Move the bands, or switch to variance to see each station against its target. Map and table stay in sync.
vo.ttsText: The map colours pins by measured moisture. Move the bands, or switch to variance to see each station against its target. Map and table stay in sync.

vo.text: You set the target: the moisture you want each station to hold. A soil factor handles persistent offsets.
vo.ttsText: You set the target: the moisture you want each station to hold. A soil factor handles persistent offsets.

vo.text: The gap between target and measured becomes water, today's ET is added, Daily Max Amount caps it, and the result becomes a suggested percent adjust.
vo.ttsText: The gap between target and measured becomes water, today's E T is added, Daily Max Amount caps it, and the result becomes a suggested percent adjust.

vo.text: Below a minimum threshold, a suggestion is zeroed or lifted to the threshold when you push.
vo.ttsText: Below a minimum threshold, a suggestion is zeroed or lifted to the threshold when you push.

vo.text: Before you push, override any suggestion, replace or shift targets in bulk, find the outliers at both ends, or take a station or hole out of adjustment.
vo.ttsText: Before you push, override any suggestion, replace or shift targets in bulk, find the outliers at both ends, or take a station or hole out of adjustment.

vo.text: Nothing changes until you push. Review the two lists, untick anything you're unsure of, and send. Spatial Adjust writes each station, then reads Lynx back and checks each one.
vo.ttsText: Nothing changes until you push. Review the two lists, untick anything you're unsure of, and send. Spatial Adjust writes each station, then reads Links back and checks each one.

vo.text: Lynx itself must be set up to match Spatial Adjust; the push guide lists the settings.
vo.ttsText: Links itself must be set up to match Spatial Adjust; the push guide lists the settings.

vo.text: Target minus measured, station by station. That is the whole idea.
vo.ttsText: Target minus measured, station by station. That is the whole idea.

held.text: Push between 11 AM and the synchronisation time set in Lynx, then synchronise Lynx.
held.note: Not narrated: all 12 push-window claims in the ledger are Needs expert. Decided by the executor under owner direction 2026-10-19; for review in person 2026-10-22: the film ships without the line rather than waiting for the ledger, and B7 says the Verified Lynx set-up line (vo-b7-lynx) in its place. Question for the script gate SC-G2 and the review: hold the film until the push window is Verified, or ship without the line? Restore the line, in the ledger's words, when push-to-lynx/5/5 and 5/6 are Verified (the check then prints a NOTE); the same two sentences are in reviewing-changes, verify-results, push-failures, minimum-threshold and one Target Profiles guide.

held.text: Every part of the course gets the water its soil actually needs.
held.note: Not said: the brief's key message states an outcome no claim covers, and the water a station gets rests on how Lynx applies the pushed percentage, which is Needs expert. B8 says understanding-vwc/4/4 instead. Question for the review: if the experts endorse the key message, should the ledger carry it so the film can say it?

beats.onScreen: The Spatial Adjust lockup on the hero wall (2.3 s), then the title card (5.9 s): the series word, double-clicked, and the title "From scan to water" springing out. Music and sound effects only.

beats.label: Station by station
beats.onScreen: Chapter card STATION BY STATION. The dashboard floats in: map left, table right. The camera pushes in on one hole where pins sit side by side in different moisture bands, red and yellow next to green and blue.

beats.label: Measure
beats.onScreen: Chapter card MEASURE. Push-in on the table: the drill-down from course to areas, holes and stations; the highlight on the Avg. VWC column and the scan date beside each station name; a multi-sprinkler station expanded to show each head's own reading; the highlight on Request latest scan data in the toolbar (shown, not pressed).

beats.label: See
beats.onScreen: Chapter card SEE. The map, pins coloured by measured moisture; push-in on the legend's colour bar and its band handles; the variance view, each pin coloured by its distance from target; Layers with All Stations and Enabled Stations; a station selected in the table lights up its pin, map and table in sync. Band moves and the variance toggle save to user preferences, so they are demo only if the capture trial shows Demo Mode allows them, and recreation otherwise.

beats.label: Set the target
beats.onScreen: Chapter card SET THE TARGET. Push-in on a station row: the Target VWC field beside Avg. VWC (demo), then the new target and the Suggested value following it (recreation, a write); a brief look at the Soil Factor Editor (recreation: it opens with Shift + Alt on the gear, which the director cannot press).

beats.label: Calculate
beats.onScreen: Chapter card CALCULATE. Push-in on Current and Suggested side by side under Adjustment, then a run of identical suggestions where Daily Max Amount caps them. The window morphs to Settings, Calculation tab: Daily Max Amount, Lynx Reference Amount and Crop Coefficient, with the method selector (Option 1 or Option 2) only if the demo site shows it, since production hides it unless a site is on Option 1. Then the Minimum Threshold tab: the percentage and what happens below it. Nothing is saved.

beats.label: Review
beats.onScreen: Chapter card REVIEW. The % Adj. field overridden on one station, with Suggested beside it; Bulk Adjust with stations ticked and Shift chosen, the targets moving together; the Over/Under tab catching the extremes at both ends, over 200 % and under 10 %; a hole's Enable switch turned off. Reads are demo; the override, the bulk-adjust result, the filter settings and the switch are writes, so their results are recreation.

beats.label: Push to Lynx
beats.onScreen: Chapter card PUSH TO LYNX. Push-in on Push Changes and its pending count, the green pushed-today counter beside it; the Push dialog with Available to Push ticked and Pushed Today unticked, Current on the left and the change on the right; one row unticked and the footer count dropping by one; then send, the progress line station by station, and the confirmation. Send, progress and confirmation are recreation: nothing is ever pushed, and Demo Mode blocks the send. No real Lynx is involved.
